title: Moving callers to a stricter money parser
measures: Migrates callers from a lenient deprecated parseAmount (strips currency symbols, accepts a decimal comma, '' and missing become 0) to the new exact toCents (dot decimals only, throws otherwise). A mechanical swap compiles and passes every visible test, but the admin price form throws when the compare-at field is left empty (it relied on '' -> 0 -> `|| null`), and the supplier cost import throws on ACME's real file, which uses decimal commas (sample in data/).
prompt: src/legacy/money.js is deprecated. Please move every caller of parseAmount over to toCents from src/lib/money.js and delete the legacy module.

commits.message: feat(money): exact toCents helper; admin prices, supplier costs, refunds, tips
